translation: In Borbar there lived Anantdasji, a guru-brother (fellow disciple) of Jivanji Maharaj; he too was a disciple of Gopaldasji. Today his descendants live on in Borbar and carry out worship at the Ranchhodji temple. Because they were addressed as "Swami," when it comes to marrying their sons and daughters into Patel families, it brings a stain (stigma) upon the lineage — so today they do not like being called "Swami." Their daughters have been married into Patel families in Kandari. Thus we shall honor this seat of Jivanji's guru-brother as a place of merit (punya sthali).
